# Path of Lock
Difficulty: [color=orange]Medium[/color]
The Path of Lock revolves around access, area denial, theft and gadgets. Pick this path if you want a less confrontational playstyle and more interested in being a slippery rat.
## Pros
- Your mansus grasp can open any lock, unlock every terminal and bypass any access restriction. - Lock heretics get some side knowledge for free, making it the perfect path if you want to experiment with the various trinkets the shop has to offer. - Lock heretics don't gain visible aura after losing the ability to break blades, making it perfect for being stealthy at latter stages.
## Cons
- The weakest heretic path in direct combat, period. - Very limited direct combat benefits. - You have no defensive benefits or immunities. - No mobility or direct additional teleportation - Highly reliant on sourcing power from other departments, players and the game world.
## Knowledge
### A Steward's Secret
Ingredients/Type: Knife, Crowbar
Creates a key blade.
### Grasp of Lock
Ingredients/Type: Passive Ability
Your grasp can unlock anything.
### Key Keepers Burden
Ingredients/Type: Door, ID Card, Iron rod
Creates a Eldritch Card, allows you to link two doors to be portals for heretics, but randomly teleport heathens. It can also absorb access from id card by eating them.
### Wrong Key
Ingredients/Type: Screwdriver, (budget) insulated gloves, wirecutter
An item that traps doors causing them to pull and crush heathens.
### Burglar's Finesse
Ingredients/Type: Passive Ability
Alt-click target with your blade in combat mode to steal their held item.
### Opening Blade
Ingredients/Type: Passive Ability
Your blade is now better at wounding and can cause weeping avulsion on attack.
### Concierge's Rite
Ingredients/Type: Crayon, Wooden plank, Multitool
Creates a labyrinth handbook, a magic item that can materialize barricades that noone can pass.
### Unlock the Labyrinth
Ingredients/Type: Three corpses with removed hearts
Creates a labyrinth portal that rapidly summons creatures from Mansus, loyal to you. You get pressure and temperature immunity. Your blades are even deadlier. You can shapeshift into empowered creatures of Mansus.
## Armor and Passive Ability
### T1 Passive
Grants you one free side knowledge for every tier.
### Shifting Guise
Hides you from camera vision and from people far away, muffles footsteps and conceals your voice.
### T2 Passive
Your grasp no longer goes on cooldown from opening locks.
### T3 Passive
X-ray vision.
## Tips
- Your mansus grasp allows you to access everything, from airlocks, consoles and even exosuits, but it has no additional effects on players. It will however leave a mark that when triggered will make your victim unable to leave the room you are in. - Your blade also functions as a crowbar! You can store it in utility belts And, in a pitch, use it to force open an airlock. - Weeping avulsion triggered by your blade cannot be healed by topicals and chemicals, requiring surgery to heal. - Triggering weeping avulsion on mangled torso force opens its ribcage, allowing you to easier ascend by removing heart via surgery. - Your Eldritch ID can create a portal between 2 different airlocks. Useful if you want to establish a secret base. - Use your labyrinth book to shake off pursuers. It creates impassible walls to anyone.
